searchText: > Do we accept that the block coinbase lose funds from a transaction if gas price < BASEFEE because of fee cap ? <@574864862338088960> Thr problem with allowing that is that a miner could choose someone else as coinbase and drain their money So we do need to enforce gasprice >= basefee Thanks <@!273808422753796097> . Would be better to make it clear in the EIP specification. Currently it is stated If GASPRICE < BASEFEE (due to the FEECAP), this means that the block.coinbase loses funds from this operation; in this case, we check that the post-balance is non-negative and throw an exception if it is negative. I will implement a new block validation rule to enforce this check in Besu. However Besu implementation will not be compatible anymore with Geth's current PR for this specific use case. The first EIP-1559 Implementers' Call is scheduled for next Thursday, April 30, 14:00 UTC. **Agenda**: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/167 **Zoom**: To be posted here shortly before the call. Please add any topics you'd like to see discussed on the Github issue. Looking forward 😄 Thanks! 😄
